learning_outcomes.text: Provide the usual knowledge of a second Analysis course, as needed for an Engineering degree course, with an emphasis on knowledge with high application potential.
Acquire the ability to apply knowledge and understanding.

syllabus_topics: Differential and integral calculus of functions of several variables; introduction to integral theorems
Analytic functions on complex numbers; introduction to linear partial differential equations; exercises

assessment_methods.method: Oral examination (optional, to verify the written test grade)

assessment_rules: The assessment consists of a 90-minute written test. In individual cases, the instructor reserves the right to verify the grade obtained in the written test with a brief oral examination. The overall evaluation is a final grade.
